Varje fullt block får en hash av sitt in: Every full block gets a hash of its contents and the hash of the previous block. Two requests with the same beginning therefore get the same hash chain.

Frontend (HTTP, text) och EngineCore (id: The frontend (HTTP, text) and EngineCore (ids, GPU) are separate processes. The engine runs in steps: schedule, execute, update.
KV-minnet är en pool av block om 16 toke: KV memory is a pool of blocks of 16 tokens. One block table per sequence maps logical blocks to physical ones.
Prefix caching: en hashkedja över fulla: Prefix caching: a hash chain over full blocks lets common prompt beginnings be shared.
Continuous batching och chunked prefill:: Continuous batching and chunked prefill: the batch is decided anew in every step within a token budget.
Batchen plattas ut till [N_tokens, 4096]: The batch is flattened to [N_tokens, 4096]. Logits are computed only for the last token of each request.
Tensor parallelism delar varje matris (t: Tensor parallelism splits every matrix (two all-reduces per layer). Speculative decoding verifies several tokens per pass.
Sist i varje steg väljs ett ord per konv: Last in every step, one word is chosen per conversation, with that conversation’s own settings.
Alla requests i batchen samplas samtidig: All requests in the batch are sampled at the same time. Each request’s parameters (temperature, top_p, seed) sit in tensors with shape [num_reqs], so the same kernels handle different settings per row.
<b>Penalties</b> sänker logits för token: Penalties lower the logits of tokens that have already appeared (repetition, presence, frequency).
<b>Structured output</b> (JSON schema, r: Structured output (JSON schema, regex, grammar): a state machine knows which tokens are valid next. All others get logit −∞ before sampling. The model then cannot produce invalid JSON, whatever it “wants”.
Masken är en bitmask över hela vokabulär: The mask is a bitmask over the whole vocabulary, [num_reqs, 128256], computed on the CPU in parallel with the forward pass.
Sampler-pipeline: logits, penalties, gra: Sampler pipeline: logits, penalties, grammar mask, temperature, top-k and top-p, sampling

Stora modellen kör alla k positioner i e: The large model runs all k positions in one pass, like a mini prefill.
Förslag accepteras från vänster tills fö: Proposals are accepted from the left until the first divergence. There the large model’s own token is used.
En liten snabb modell gissar några ord f: A small, fast model guesses a few words ahead, and the large model checks all the guesses at once.
Decode är memory-bound: att verifiera 5: Decode is memory-bound: verifying 5 tokens in one forward pass costs almost as little as generating 1. Speculative decoding exploits that.
Med sampling används rejection sampling:: With sampling, rejection sampling is used: accept with probability min(1, p/q). The outcome then has exactly the same distribution as the large model alone.
Utan spekulation: 4 pass genom stora mod: Without speculation: 4 passes through the large model for 4 tokens.

<b>Column parallel</b> (qkv, gate_up): v: Column parallel (qkv, gate_up): every GPU gets a slice of the output columns. Attention is split per head: with TP = 2 each GPU gets 16 query heads and 4 KV heads.

När en modell är för stor för ett grafik: When a model is too big for one GPU, every table is split across several GPUs. They each compute their own part and then reconcile.
När modellen inte får plats på en GPU, e: When the model does not fit on one GPU, or needs to run faster, every weight matrix is split across the GPUs.
Två all-reduce per lager, alltså 64 per: Two all-reduces per layer, that is 64 per forward pass in Llama-3-8B. It requires fast links such as NVLink, so TP is mostly used within one server.

Tre saker vLLM gör bättre än en enkel lö: Three things vLLM does better than a simple solution
No memory is reserved unnecessarily. Every conversation gets new memory blocks only once it needs them.
<b>Kortet står aldrig och väntar på att: The GPU never sits waiting for a group to finish. Every step is filled with the questions that exist right then.
<b>Samma arbete görs inte två gånger.</b: The same work is not done twice. Common beginnings of questions are computed once and shared.
Modellen själv kan bara räkna ut nästa o: The model itself can only work out the next word for one text. vLLM is the program around the model that takes questions from many users, divides the GPU’s memory between them and makes sure the GPU always has as much useful work as possible. Think of a restaurant with a single, very fast kitchen.
Allt det här finns för att grafikkortet,: All of this exists because the GPU, as we saw, mostly waits on memory. The more users that share each weight read, the more answers per second.

vLLM delar upp arbetet i en frontend som: vLLM splits the work into a frontend that speaks HTTP and text, and an engine that only sees token ids and GPU memory.
Motorn arbetar i <b>steg</b>: varje steg: The engine works in steps: in each step the scheduler picks a batch, workers run a forward pass, and every active request gets (usually) one new token. In the code the three parts are called schedule(), execute_model() and update_from_output(). Then the next step begins. Everything else in this module is about how the steps get filled.
